entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry... I fell asleep...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Did you get enough rest?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mona-chan?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Anyway, it's just as I told you[n]a moment ago.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I can't have you guys risk your lives[n]anymore for someone useless like me.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: To be frank, there's no assurance that I'll[n]turn back into a human either...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This can't be called a fair deal. That's why[n]I think we should split up.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Who said we're acting as Phantom[n]Thieves for your sake? I'm doing it to[n]expand my own horizons.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No need to tiptoe around the situation.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're splitting up.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You should stop lying.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you remember what you said to me[n]when I found you collapsed in the[n]Metaverse?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That you're a phantom thief. That you're[n]going to get stronger and have the others[n]acknowledge you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You love being here, don't you?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: O-Of course not...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was lying to myself too, but when I[n]formed a contract with my Persona...[n]I understood it all.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Doing this because my father is doing[n]something horrible... was nothing but[n]a superficial reason.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The truth is, I—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't want to get married, right?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I thought that since an adult with[n]responsibilities made the decision,[n]it couldn't be wrong.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was such a fool, tied down by vague[n]notions and stayed quiet as my marriage[n]partner was chosen...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But I won't tolerate this anymore.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I can't stand that creep!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Phew... That's how I truly feel.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wh-Why're you looking at me all of a[n]sudden?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mona-chan, why is it that you always[n]talked about becoming human again?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At first, I only thought of this team as[n]a temporary dwelling until I regained[n]my memories.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But I wasn't making any progress on[n]finding out what I am or why I was born...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Morgana...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I wanted a reason of my own—a reason[n]to stay with the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't have anyone I want to save or get[n]revenge on. Someone like me has no[n]reason to stay here...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's why... to me... this team is...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Come on, say it! You can do it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's the only place I can belong![n]I wanna stay here forever!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That was refreshingly honest.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You shoulda just said so from the start![n]Geez!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you stick with me, there's no telling[n]what kind of trouble will come up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You better be sure about this!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's a little late for all that, don't[n]you think?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Of course we want to stay with[n]you too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uhh, so... well...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I'm sorry I worried you guys.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is where I belong! My mind's all set!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll make sure to work hard to pay my[n]dues. It's too late to cancel our deal,[n]got it?
Let's do it, together.
I expect great things.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're reforming our give-and-take deal.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I'd better make up for the time we[n]wasted dallying around.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, in the end, wouldn't you say that[n]your encounter with us was destiny?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right... "Encounter"...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hm?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh crap! The last train's comin' up!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must go as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's continue this another time.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Stay at our place. I'll arrange it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: See you all tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm gonna sleep. I'm exhausted.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Man. This place is as drab as always...
I feel like my bond with Morgana[n]is growing deeper...
